name: Foraging
flavor: Working the passive sources — mats, films, drifting particles. The gather grind: every level strips a richer harvest from the same patch.

name: Hunting
flavor: Taking living, defended prey. It doesn't crack their armour — that's your body — but a trained hunter strips far more from every kill.

name: Fortitude
flavor: Hardened by everything that bit back and failed. Blunts the retaliation tax so a dangerous node stops shredding your throughput.
